label: r3c1
name: Per-type soft cell permutation
hypothesis: Each type slot's map is passed through a learned row-softmax cell permutation P[T,YX,YX]. P starts at zero logits, so the mix is uniform. This covers any per-type anchor scramble, roll, stride or offset with 16k weights instead of r2c3's 131k-weight remap, which is kept as a fallback. If the anchors are scrambled within each type, this should clearly beat 0.018 on both seeds. Scores ≤0.02 refute a per-type cell remap.
